title: Oil Infused Jamaican Sardine Pilaf
description: A flavorful and light Jamaican dish featuring sardines, this pilaf is a crowd-pleaser and can be made gluten-free friendly, with a jammy texture from the infused oil.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the chopped scotch bonnet pepper and cook for an additional minute.
Add the dried thyme and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the uncooked white rice and stir to coat the rice with the oil and mix with the onion and pepper.
Add the chicken broth and salt, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Stir in the chopped sardines and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
